“谁啊？”
“这人是上海的一家工厂的会计，还说自己在业余班学过表演。”谢铁骊将照片递给了刘济民。
这不是斯丹康本尊吗？
刘济民嘴角一下子咧到了耳朵根，谢铁骊好奇地问道：“怎么？长得有这么好笑吗？”
“这大鼻子，比管宗祥同志的鼻子都大，像是一家人。”刘济民笑道，“怎么有人的鼻子这么大？”
谢铁骊拿回刘长伟的照片后，又将马小伟的照片递给了他：“你看这个人呢？是沪影厂的新演员。”
得，这个是光头专业户！
不过这时候的马小伟，头发还很浓密，要演小包的话，也能说得过去。
但话又说回来了，谁让刘长伟投了。
“个子太高，一米八二，站那儿比宝珣都高了吧？自卑不好演。”刘济民点评道。
“我看，让他们两个都来吧，个子太高，他就弯着腰，反正咱们得尽快选一个。”
刘济民笑道：“一根胡萝卜吊两头驴，就看谁拉的好！”
“哈哈哈！”谢铁骊抚掌笑道，“你呀你呀你，搞得我像剥削人的地主，这不是吃不到的胡萝卜，人来了不合适，咱报销车票还给补贴。”
谢铁骊立即给刘长伟和马小伟拍了一封电报，邀请他们速来燕影厂试镜，衣食住行，燕影厂一概包了。
沪市距离燕京较远，两人再收拾一下，估计过来还得三四天。
九月一号，医学科学院开学。刘济民和朱霖回去报了个到就走了，燕影厂出了一个借调函，将两人暂时调到燕影厂拍电影。
学校听说后，是一百二十个配合。在这年代，能参与电影拍摄的任务，那是极光荣的事情，不亚于上级下达的政治任务。
杨波拉着刘济民，询问他什么时候能去拍戏。
“放心，我有数！”刘济民拍了拍胸脯，保证道。

"Who?"
"This man is an accountant at a factory in Shanghai. He also said that he studied acting in an amateur class." Xie Tieli handed the photo to Liu Jimin.
Isn't this Stan Kang himself?
Liu Jimin grinned from the corner of his mouth to his ears, and Xie Tieli asked curiously: "What? Does he look so funny?"
"This big nose is bigger than Comrade Guan Zongxiang's nose. It's like a family member." Liu Jimin said with a smile, "Why does someone have such a big nose?"
After Xie Tieli took back Liu Changwei's photo, he handed him Ma Xiaowei's photo: "What do you think of this person? He is a new actor from Shanghai Film Studio."
Yes, this is a bald professional!
But at this time, Ma Xiaowei's hair was still very thick, so if he wanted to play Xiao Bao, it would be reasonable.
But then again, who asked Liu Changwei to vote?
"You are too tall, 1.82 meters tall. Standing there, you are taller than Bao Xun, right? It's hard to act because you have low self-esteem." Liu Jimin commented.
"I think let's have both of them. If he's too tall, he'll bend over. Anyway, we have to choose one as soon as possible."
Liu Jimin laughed and said: "One carrot hangs two donkeys, it depends on who can pull it better!"
"Hahaha!" Xie Tieli said with a smile, stroking his hands, "You, you, you, you make me look like a landlord who exploits people. This is not a carrot that cannot be eaten. If the person comes, it is not suitable. We will reimburse the ticket and give you a subsidy."
Xie Tieli immediately sent a telegram to Liu Changwei and Ma Xiaowei, inviting them to come to Yanying Studio for auditions. The Yanying Factory would cover all their food, clothing, housing and transportation.
Shanghai City is far away from Yanjing. It will take three or four days for the two of them to tidy up.
On September 1st, the Academy of Medical Sciences begins. Liu Jimin and Zhu Lin went back to report their arrival and left. Yan Film Studio issued a secondment letter, temporarily transferring them to Yan Film Studio to film a movie.
After the school heard about it, they cooperated 120 times. In this era, being able to participate in film shooting tasks is a very honorable thing, no less than a political task assigned by superiors.
Yang Bo pulled Liu Jimin and asked him when he could go filming.
"Don't worry, I know it!" Liu Jimin patted his chest and assured.
